figurative_meaning_en: to judge carefully or after due consideration
example_sentences_in_bangla: দেখে শুনে সিদ্ধান্ত নাও, তাড়াহুড়ো করো না।
ওষুধটা দেখে শুনে নকল বলে মনে হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Make a decision after looking and listening, don't rush.
The medicine seems fake after careful examination.
note: This idiom emphasizes thoughtful decision-making in Bengali culture.
